name: lws
description: Companion to the LEAPWare SessionKeeper Claude Code plugin, now with the same enforcement: an engine identical to it, an enforcing PreToolUse hook (hooks/hooks.json), and lws-config/lws-report skills.

interface.longDescription: lws makes an AI coding session's spend rules mechanical. Both the Claude Code and Codex plugins enforce via a PreToolUse hook backed by the same lws_core policy engine, with lws-config and lws-report skills for inspecting and previewing policy.
interface.defaultPrompt: lws: show the current token policy and report on the last action.
